summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose an update to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program. The filing notes daily disclosure to the ASX of any transactions under the program, with forward-looking statements regarding potential buybacks across Class A and Class B common stock. No specific terms (price, volume, dates) are provided beyond the aggregate $1B authorization. The board has already authorized the program; no advisor is named. The repurchases remain at management's discretion subject to market conditions and legal requirements. Watch for actual daily disclosure filings to assess execution pace and price support.
